bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to the Arrowhead Economic Opportunity Agency.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ARROWHEAD ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITY AGENCY. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the Arrowhead Economic Opportunity Agency. The grant recipient must use grant money as a revolving fund for acquiring and rehabilitating tax-forfeited properties for owner occupancy. Housing funded with this grant must be affordable to the local work force. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to the Arrowhead Economic Opportunity Agency.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ARROWHEAD ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITY AGENCY.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the Arrowhead Economic Opportunity Agency. The grant recipient must use grant money as a revolving fund for acquiring and rehabilitating tax-forfeited properties for owner occupancy. Housing funded with this grant must be affordable to the local work force. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the Arrowhead Economic Opportunity Agency. Housing funded with this grant must be affordable to the local work force. This is a onetime appropriation.
